name: Public merger-spread intraday normalization
hypothesis: Trade only a preregistered executable spread deviation with all required authorized hedge legs and no new adverse deal information.
spec: Setup: A public transaction can create a temporarily wide but risky spread. Entry: Trade only a preregistered executable spread deviation with all required authorized hedge legs and no new adverse deal information. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on normalization, deal-news change, or same-session stop. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs primary filings / corporate-event data with receipt times (licensed feed)
